verdict.rationale: Exporting account data is a fair question for an online government account portal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents any bulk export of a user's data in open formats. QuickFile is an upload path for submitting wage reports from a formatted file, and the ability to close a tax account is an adjacent feature, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
